description: Convert one booking code to all 27 default target bookmakers at once (up to 27 target bookmakers: SportyBet, 1xBet Global, 1xBet NG, MSport, Paripesa, 22Bet, Megapari, 888starz, Afropari NG, Afropari Global, Betwinner, Melbet, Helabet, Fastpari, Xparibet, Goldpari, 1xBit, WinWinBet, DBBet, Paripulse, BetJam, Planbet, Linebet, Luckypari, Bet9ja, BetKing, Football.com), or pass a custom targets subset. Uses per-family concurrency lanes. Costs 2 credits per successful target code; failed targets cost 0 credits. Country variants are opt-in through the targets list.

include_card.description: Set true to also render a 1080x1920 PNG share card with all converted codes.

targets.description: Optional list of target bookmaker keys. Omit to convert to all eligible bookmakers.

name: mbc_convert_to_all
title: Convert One Bet Code to All Bookmakers
